# TECRID

> TECRID provides digital testing records and public verification pages. The public site explains the record standard, verification model and integration contract.

Interpret each record according to its program, issuer, version, current status and authorized scope. A laboratory result is not a product certification. TEST or sandbox examples are distinct from production records. Public verification metadata does not grant access to private reports or results.

## Public documentation

- [Home](https://tecrid.com/): TECRID overview.
- [What is a TECRID?](https://tecrid.com/what-is-a-tecrid): Testing records and their purpose.
- [The standard](https://tecrid.com/standard): The public record standard.
- [Verify a record](https://tecrid.com/verify): Public verification entry point.
- [Verification](https://tecrid.com/verification): How verification is presented.
- [Developers](https://tecrid.com/developers): Published integration documentation.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://tecrid.com/faq): Public questions and answers.
- [Disclosures](https://tecrid.com/disclosures): Disclosures about the service.
